sourceAuthorities: MV-IA-F021 Autosave Reconnect Recovery and Bounded Offline Use
IA-D04-002 through IA-D04-004 shared approval recovery and result contracts

resolvedFindings.finding: Graph geometry can become the only meaning carrier.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require textual node/edge semantics and six equivalent views.

resolvedFindings.finding: Drag-first editing excludes keyboard, screen-reader, and precision-limited users.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require command and form alternatives for every operation.

resolvedFindings.finding: Hidden topology can leak through counts, gaps, coordinates, or routing.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Filter before topology and layout generation; suppress by default.

resolvedFindings.finding: Canvas focus order can become unstable and meaningless.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Use deterministic semantic navigation independent of coordinates.

resolvedFindings.finding: Responsive collapse can remove feature completeness.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Default mobile to list/outline while preserving every operation.

resolvedFindings.finding: Virtualization and reconnect can lose context.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Preserve semantic position and restore focus against fresh authorized projections.

resolvedFindings.finding: Automated checks alone can overstate accessibility readiness.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Require both deterministic automation and a recorded manual-review gate before release.
